# 1 - Set paths + root for inputs

```{r}

pacman::p_load(
  tidycensus,
  mapcdatakeys,
  janitor,
  readxl,
  stringr,
  data.table,
  here,
  arrow,
  tidyverse,
  dplyr
)

##get rid of scientific notation
options(scipen = 999)
#Set random seed
set.seed(351)

#Set up muni data keys

mpos <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> 
  pull(mpo) |> 
  unique()

# Munis by RPA/MPO
munis <- all_muni_data_keys |> 
  select(muni_id, rpa_acr, mpo) |> 
  setDT()

# Bring in helper functions
source(here('scripts/Projections.Functions.R'))

# Paths
if (grepl('VM',Sys.info()[['nodename']])){
  base <- '//data-sync/Public/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
} else {
  base <- 'S:/Network Shares/K Drive/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
}

root <- paste0(base,'Projections/Projections_2028/Data/01_Regional_Control_Totals/')

urb.path <- paste0(root,'UrbanSim_base_pop/')
raw.path <- paste0(urb.path,'ma_state_base_data_2010_2020_v20261005/')
rwt.path <- paste0(root, 'Reweighter/LRTP_2028/')
mapcm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'MAPCM/Input_Files/')
swm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'SWM/Input_Files/')

shop.path <- paste0(base, "Housing/StatewideHousingPlan/04_Analysis/Data/Working/Regional_Control_Totals/Scenario_3/UPDATE/")

# Set knitr path
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```


# 2 - Generate Baseline data for each target category using UrbanSim base year 2020 microsim pop (which is based on 2019-2023 PUMS)


```{r}

pums_data97 <- fread(paste0(root,'PUMS/pums_2023_urbansim_baseline_MAPC97.csv'))
pums_data101 <- fread(paste0(root,'PUMS/pums_2023_urbansim_baseline_MAPC101.csv'))

# Baseline data for MAPC 101

  hhtype.baseline101 <- pums_data101 |>
    filter(SPORDER == 1) |>
    rename(RPA = rpa_acr) |>
    group_by(RPA, AgeCat) |>
    # Sum the household weights in the PUMS data.
    dplyr::count(
      var = HHtype,
      wt = WGTP
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    dplyr::rename(
      HHtype = var,
      BASELINE = n,
      AgeCat = AgeCat
    ) |>
    # Rename variables to match the reweighter input requirements.
    mutate(
      HHtype = paste0("x == ", HHtype),
      AgeCat = paste0("x == ", AgeCat),
      INTER = BASELINE
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(HHtype == "x == 1" |HHtype == "x == 3" | HHtype == "x == 5")
  
  # 7.1.3 Tenure baseline
  tenure.baseline101 <- pums_data101 |>
    # Filter for households and the head of household for each SERIALNO
    filter(TYPEHUGQ == "1" & SPORDER == 1) |>
    rename(RPA = rpa_acr) |>
    group_by(RPA, AgeCat) |>
    # Sum the household weights in the PUMS data.
    dplyr::count(
      var = tenure,
      wt = WGTP
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    dplyr::rename(
      tenure = var,
      BASELINE = n
    ) |>
    # Rename variables to match the reweigher input requirements.
    mutate(
      AgeCat = paste0("x == ", AgeCat),
      tenure = paste0("x == ", tenure),
      INTER = BASELINE
    ) |>
    relocate(AgeCat, .after = RPA)
  
  #===============================================================================
  # QC for baseline files. Compare total household baseline for HHtype and Tenure baseline files.
  if (sum(hhtype.baseline101$BASELINE) != sum(tenure.baseline101$BASELINE)) {
    print("STOP! Please review scripts which create the baseline data for the targeting files.")
  } else {
    print("Proceed!")
  }
  
  #===============================================================================
  # Write baseline files
  
  # Output the baseline file for Household Type aggregations
  fwrite(hhtype.baseline101, paste0(rwt.path, "hhtype_baseline_MAPC101.csv"))
  
  # Output the baseline file for Age of Householder by tenure aggregations
  fwrite(tenure.baseline101, paste0(rwt.path, "tenure_baseline_MAPC101.csv"))
  
# Baseline data for MAPC97
  
  hhtype.baseline97 <- pums_data97 |>
    filter(SPORDER == 1) |>
    rename(RPA = mpo) |>
    group_by(RPA, AgeCat) |>
    # Sum the household weights in the PUMS data.
    dplyr::count(
      var = HHtype,
      wt = WGTP
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    dplyr::rename(
      HHtype = var,
      BASELINE = n,
      AgeCat = AgeCat
    ) |>
    # Rename variables to match the reweighter input requirements.
    mutate(
      HHtype = paste0("x == ", HHtype),
      AgeCat = paste0("x == ", AgeCat),
      INTER = BASELINE
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(HHtype == "x == 1" |HHtype == "x == 3" | HHtype == "x == 5")
  
  # 7.1.3 Tenure baseline
  tenure.baseline97 <- pums_data97 |>
    # Filter for households and the head of household for each SERIALNO
    filter(TYPEHUGQ == "1" & SPORDER == 1) |>
    rename(RPA = mpo) |>
    group_by(RPA, AgeCat) |>
    # Sum the household weights in the PUMS data.
    dplyr::count(
      var = tenure,
      wt = WGTP
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    dplyr::rename(
      tenure = var,
      BASELINE = n
    ) |>
    # Rename variables to match the reweigher input requirements.
    mutate(
      AgeCat = paste0("x == ", AgeCat),
      tenure = paste0("x == ", tenure),
      INTER = BASELINE
    ) |>
    relocate(AgeCat, .after = RPA)
  
  #===============================================================================
  # QC for baseline files. Compare total household baseline for HHtype and Tenure baseline files.
  if (sum(hhtype.baseline97$BASELINE) != sum(tenure.baseline97$BASELINE)) {
    print("STOP! Please review scripts which create the baseline data for the targeting files.")
  } else {
    print("Proceed!")
  }
  
  #===============================================================================
  # Write baseline files
  
  # Output the baseline file for Household Type aggregations
  fwrite(hhtype.baseline97, paste0(rwt.path, "hhtype_baseline_MAPC97.csv"))
  
  # Output the baseline file for Age of Householder by tenure aggregations
  fwrite(tenure.baseline97, paste0(rwt.path, "tenure_baseline_MAPC97.csv"))
  
```

# 3.2 - Join baseline data to SHoP Scenario 3 target data

```{r}

# Load baseline data

hhtype.baseline97 <- fread(paste0(rwt.path, "hhtype_baseline_MAPC97.csv"))
tenure.baseline97 <- fread(paste0(rwt.path, "tenure_baseline_MAPC97.csv"))

hhtype.baseline101 <- fread(paste0(rwt.path, "hhtype_baseline_MAPC101.csv"))
tenure.baseline101 <- fread(paste0(rwt.path, "tenure_baseline_MAPC101.csv"))

# Combine with target files from SHoP Scenario 3

for (i in seq(2025, 2050, 5)) {
  print(paste0("Generating MAPC101 Reweighter Target Files for ", i, "."))
  
  hhtype.target <- fread(
    paste0(
      mapcm.path,
      "SHoP_target_files/hhtype.targetfile.MAPC101.Scenario_3.hdshp.scen2.y",
      i,
      ".csv"
    )
  ) |>
    select(-BASELINE, -INTER) |>
    full_join(hhtype.baseline101, by = c("RPA", "AgeCat", "HHtype")) |>
    # Baseline files may not have every age group, household type segment that the projections have.
    # Need to fill in places in the baseline where there are zeros for those segments.
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0))) |>
    filter(RPA == 'MAPC') |>
    relocate(TARGET, .after=INTER) |> 
    setDT()
  
  ten.target <- fread(
    paste0(
      mapcm.path,
      "SHoP_target_files/tenure.targetfile.MAPC101.Scenario_3.hdshp.scen2.y",
      i,
      ".csv"
    )
  ) |>
    select(-BASELINE, -INTER) |>
    full_join(tenure.baseline101, by = c("RPA", "AgeCat", "tenure")) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0))) |>
    filter(RPA == 'MAPC') |>
    relocate(TARGET, .after=INTER) |> 
    setDT()
  
  if (sum(hhtype.target$TARGET) != sum(ten.target$TARGET)) {
    print("STOP! Please review target file creation code.")
  } else{
    print("Proceed.")
  }
  
  fwrite(hhtype.target,
         paste0(mapcm.path, 'hhtype.targetfile.MAPC101.y', i, '.csv'))
  
  fwrite(ten.target,
         paste0(mapcm.path, 'tenure.targetfile.MAPC101.y', i, '.csv'))
  
}

#===============================================================================
  # MAPC97/MPO Versions
#===============================================================================

for (i in seq(2025, 2050, 5)) {
  print(paste0("Generating MAPC97 Reweighter Target Files for ", i, "."))
  
  hhtype.target <- fread(
    paste0(
      swm.path,
      "SHoP_target_files/hhtype.targetfile.MAPC97.Scenario_3.hdshp.scen2.y",
      i,
      ".csv"
    )
  ) |>
    select(-BASELINE, -INTER) |>
    full_join(hhtype.baseline97, by = c("RPA", "AgeCat", "HHtype")) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0))) |>
    relocate(TARGET, .after=INTER) |> 
    setDT()
  
  ten.target <- fread(
    paste0(
      swm.path,
      "SHoP_target_files/tenure.targetfile.MAPC97.Scenario_3.hdshp.scen2.y",
      i,
      ".csv"
    )
  ) |>
    select(-BASELINE, -INTER) |>
    full_join(tenure.baseline97, by = c("RPA", "AgeCat", "tenure")) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0))) |>
    relocate(TARGET, .after=INTER) |> 
    setDT()
  
  if (sum(hhtype.target$TARGET) != sum(ten.target$TARGET)) {
    print("STOP! Please review target file creation code.")
  } else{
    print("Proceed.")
  }
  
  fwrite(hhtype.target,
```
